Package com.csse3200.game.cards.effects

Record Class CardPlayResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.csse3200.game.cards.effects.CardPlayResult
public record CardPlayResult(boolean success, String failureReason, String cardId, String targetId, List<ResolvedCardEffect> enemyEffects, List<ResolvedCardEffect> playerEffects, List<String> updatedHand, List<String> updatedDrawPile, List<String> updatedDiscardPile, int energyCost) extends Record
One-stop result of a single card-play attempt.

This mirrors the shape Team 5's card system is moving towards: Team 3 makes one call for a card play and everything it needs to refresh the UI and hand work to other systems comes back here. Until Team 5's real entry point lands, CardResolutionService fills this in on the Team 3 side.

On failure no effects are produced and the card stays in hand. On success the deck snapshots already reflect the played card moved from hand to discard, and energyCost() is the energy that was spent.

  • Method Details

    • failure

      public static CardPlayResult failure(String reason, String cardId, String targetId, BattleDeck deck)
      Builds a failed result. No effects, card stays in hand, deck snapshots are unchanged.
      Parameters:
      reason - human-readable reason the card could not be played
      cardId - the card that was attempted
      targetId - the requested target
      deck - the (unchanged) battle deck to snapshot
      Returns:
      a failed result

    • success

      public static CardPlayResult success(String cardId, String targetId, List<ResolvedCardEffect> enemyEffects, List<ResolvedCardEffect> playerEffects, BattleDeck deck, int energyCost)
      Builds a successful result. Deck snapshots should be taken after the card has been moved to the discard pile.
      Parameters:
      cardId - the card that was played
      targetId - the target the card was played on
      enemyEffects - resolved effects for enemy-facing systems (Team 1)
      playerEffects - resolved effects for player-facing systems (Team 7)
      deck - the battle deck to snapshot, already updated
      energyCost - energy that was spent playing the card
      Returns:
      a successful result
